commentary.text: 90+4' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+3' A pass by Nicolo Barella (Inter) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
90' We will have 3 min. of added time.
90' Inter enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
88' Inter failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
86' Como are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
81' Cesc Fabregas decides to make a substitution. Ignace Van der Brempt will be replaced by Jonathan Ikone (Como).
81' Substitution. Nico Paz makes his way off the pitch and Alessio Iovine (Como) comes on as his replacement.
80' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Luka Topalovic (Inter) comes onto the pitch so that Nicola Zalewski can be given a rest.
79' Nicolo Barella (Inter) neatly controls a driven pass on the edge of the box, glances up and cracks a beautiful drive goalwards that sails just over the bar.
78' The resulting corner, taken by Denzel Dumfries (Inter), comes to nothing.
78' Joaquin Correa (Inter) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
73' Masssimiliano Farris prepares a substitution. Mehdi Taremi is replaced by Marko Arnautovic (Inter).
71' The Inter players are exchanging some short passes.
63' Denzel Dumfries (Inter) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
60' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Francesco Acerbi (Inter) replaces Federico Dimarco.
60' Masssimiliano Farris has decided to substitute Hakan Calhanoglu and he is replaced by Nicolo Barella (Inter).
60' Denzel Dumfries comes onto the pitch after Yann Bisseck (Inter) signals to the bench that he cannot continue any longer after picking up an injury.
59' The game is interrupted now, Yann Bisseck (Inter) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
57' Davide Massa couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Federico Dimarco (Inter) and blew his whistle.
55' A pass by Federico Dimarco (Inter) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
53' A substitution has been made. Anastasios Douvikas is replaced by Patrick Cutrone (Como).
53' Cesc Fabregas has decided to make a change. Yannik Engelhardt (Como) replaces Maximo Perrone.

51' 0 - 2 Joaquin Correa (Inter) finishes his beautiful individual effort with a superb strike from inside the box. Mauro Vigorito is just a bystander as the ball flies into bottom right corner. The score is 0:2.
50' Mehdi Taremi (Inter) commits a rough foul. Davide Massa stops the game and makes a call.
49' Inter control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
48' Nico Paz (Como) decides to have a shot at goal from the free kick, but it hits the defensive wall.
47' Stefan de Vrij (Inter) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Davide Massa had an easy-decision to make.
47' Great teamplay by Como as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
46' The whistle blows and Davide Massa starts the second half.
45+6' The end of the first half.
45+3' Substitution. Jean Butez (Como) replaces Maxence Caqueret.
45+1' Gabriel Strefezza (Como) is awarded a yellow card for a sharp discussion with the referee. He should relax or he could be sent off.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
45' Very strict call by the referee! He pulls out the red card and sends Pepe Reina (Como) off the pitch.

45' It's been a while since that contentious challenge by Pepe Reina (Como), but referee Davide Massa must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review and it could result in a red card!
43' Nicola Zalewski (Inter) has tested the patience of referee Davide Massa and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
43' Federico Dimarco (Inter) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross.
40' Carlos Augusto (Inter) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
39' Gabriel Strefezza (Como) gets in a header from close range after a lofted pass, but the effort flies just over the bar.
38' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) serves up a nice cross, but Pepe Reina punches the ball away.

37' Mehdi Taremi (Inter) was close to scoring a goal after unleashing a first-time effort from inside the six-yard box. The ball was aimed low towards the middle of the net, but the goalkeeper read it well and pulled off a brilliant save to thwart the attempt.

36' Ivan Smolcic (Como) latches on to a lofted pass from the resulting set piece and pulls the trigger from around the penalty spot. His effort towards the middle of the goal is saved by the excellent Yann Sommer.
35' Carlos Augusto (Inter) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.

33' Federico Dimarco (Inter) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Davide Massa blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion.
33' The Inter players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
30' Poor challenge! Lucas Da Cunha (Como) is penalised for tripping and Davide Massa blows his whistle.
30' That was close by Nico Paz (Como)! He receives a pass on the edge of the box and shoots, but the ball goes by a whisker over the crossbar.
28' What a save from Yann Sommer! Nico Paz (Como) jumps high to meet a cross and glances a promising header from close range, but the goalkeeper pulls off a brilliant stop to keep it out.
25' 38:62 – this is the current ball possession ratio.
24' That's unlucky! Nicola Zalewski (Inter) side steps a tackle after receiving a pass, advances then hits a booming shot from mid-range which only rises at the last second to fly just over the bar.
24' Maxence Caqueret (Como) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball.
20' 0 - 1 Goal! The corner is whipped in and Stefan de Vrij (Inter) is in the right place at the right time, planting his header perfectly into the right side of the goal. He makes it 0:1.
20' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) is about to take a corner kick.
20' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
19' Alex Valle (Como) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Davide Massa blows his whistle for a foul.
18' Gabriel Strefezza (Como) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box after picking up a pass, but produces a poor effort that sails high over the bar.
18' The resulting set piece from Como is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
17' Excellent touch by Nico Paz (Como)! He latches on to a precise pass on the edge of the box and produces a shot goalwards which goes way wide of the left post.
17' Matteo Darmian (Inter) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
15' Nicola Zalewski (Inter) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery.
14' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Como, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
12' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
11' The ball is cleared after Anastasios Douvikas (Como) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
10' The Como players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
8' Nico Paz (Como) commits a minor foul to interrupt the attacking move of his opponent and is warned by the referee that he will get a yellow card if he does it again.
6' Federico Dimarco (Inter) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target.
5' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Inter comes to nothing.
5' Federico Dimarco (Inter) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Pepe Reina intercepts the ball.
5' The players are out and the match is about to start. Inter will have the kick-off.
4' Matteo Darmian (Inter) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
3' A pass from Joaquin Correa (Inter) is intercepted by Pepe Reina and the move breaks down.
1' Como seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
Davide Massa will supervise the game today.
